an10.34:1.1: katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbanti.
an10.34:1.2: dasahi kho upāli dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ
an10.34:1.4: idhupāli bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an10.34:1.5: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an10.34:1.6: pātimokkhaṃ kho panassa vitthārena svāgataṃ hoti suvibhattaṃ supavattaṃ suvinicchitaṃ suttaso anubyañjanaso
an10.34:1.7: paṭibalo hoti gilānaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ vā upaṭṭhāpetuṃ vā
an10.34:1.8: paṭibalo hoti anabhiratiṃ vūpakāsetuṃ vā vūpakāsāpetuṃ vā
an10.34:1.9: paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ kukkuccaṃ dhammato vinodetuṃ
an10.34:1.10: paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ dhammato vivecetuṃ
an10.34:1.14: imehi kho upāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbanti.
